name: PP1_SP
description: Shielded pool state script for rounds of up to 8 transfers. 226-byte header with 9 fields; the body bakes in the SHA256 of the verifier and append slot scripts.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: txid whose output 0 the genesis spends (immutable)

parameters.name: rabinPubKeyHash
parameters.description: hash160 of the operator's Rabin n (immutable)

parameters.name: ring0
parameters.description: commitment root; ring0 is the current one (mutable)

parameters.name: ring1
parameters.description: commitment root; ring0 is the current one (mutable)

parameters.name: ring2
parameters.description: commitment root; ring0 is the current one (mutable)

parameters.name: ring3
parameters.description: commitment root; ring0 is the current one (mutable)

metadata.note: Pushdata prefixes (0x20, 0x14, 0x01, 0x04) are part of the static hex. A round spends this output together with the K verifier slots and the append slot minted by the same transaction.
